items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today” Hadjar ...
items.summaryEn:
Isack Hadjar has also been summoned to the stewards tomorrow morning for “misconduct relating to an incident in the Formula 1 paddock today”
Hadjar pushed a fan who had tried to put an arm round him and take a selfie as he was walking to the garage #F1 #MexicoGP
detailZh:
哈贾尔 也被要求明天早上到 stewards 处接受询问，原因是“今天在 Formula 1 操场发生的违规事件”
哈贾尔 推开了一名试图绕到他身边拍照的粉丝，当时他正在走向维修区 #F1 #MexicoGP

items.titleZh: 墨西哥大奖赛周五F1赛事的胜者与败者
items.summaryZh: 墨西哥大奖赛周五的FP1练习赛中，勒克莱尔表现出色，而维斯塔潘在FP2中排名第五。
items.originalTitle: Winners and losers from Mexico's Friday F1 action
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔在周五的FP1和FP2练习赛中均排名第一。
维斯塔潘在FP2中排名第五，与李·霍斯金斯发生碰撞。
李·霍斯金斯在FP1中表现出色，有望成为红牛车队的新成员。
keyPointsEn: Verstappen finished fifth in FP2 after a collision with Lawson.
Lawson impressed in FP1, potentially opening the door for a Red Bull seat.
